description: Owner-labeled speaker ground truth for the Agent/Caller transcript relabel pass (OPENAI_TRANSCRIPT_LABEL_MODEL). Each case stores a call_log id, a sha256 of the canonical raw diarized transcript rebuilt from call_log.transcript_structured, and one speaker label per raw line — never transcript text, names, phone numbers, or addresses. Generate a labeling sheet with: node server/scripts/speaker-label-eval.js --sheet (the sheet is written to a private 0600 file — stdout stays PII-free; read it privately, paste only the corrected stubs here, then delete the file). line_speakers[i] labels the i-th non-empty line of the canonical raw transcript; transcript_sha256 pins that alignment — a re-transcribed call no longer scores (transcript_drift) instead of scoring against shifted lines.
